_meta.purpose: Older-adult population caps (50+): conservative intensity, higher RIR floor, extended recovery windows.

name: Older Adult (50+)
description: Emphasises joint-friendly movements, higher RIR margins, and adequate recovery. Strength and balance over peak performance.
notes: RIR floor of 2 reduces joint stress from near-maximal loading. Volume capped at approximately the MEV–MAV midpoint for major muscle groups. Machine/cable variants preferred for accessory work when joint tolerance is a concern.

sources: ACSM position stand on exercise and physical activity for older adults
Straight et al. 1999 older adult resistance training
Liu & Latham 2009 progressive resistance strength training for improving physical function
